PURPOSE: Answer whether the OG-PSP objective actually forced z to carry specialist identity, SEPARATELY from whether that identity clears the held-out crossover gate. V1 conflated these: it looked like specialisation had failed to transfer when in fact no specialisation ever existed.

STRICTLY_NOT_A_GATE.cannot_substitute_for_the_crossover_gate: A strong mechanism result with a failed crossover is still CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED. This diagnostic explains, it never overrides.
STRICTLY_NOT_A_GATE.runs_before_EVAL: so the mechanism reading cannot be shaped by the EVAL outcome

SPLITS.CALIB: 10700097..10700128 -- NOT in the OG-PSP bank, a clean generalisation probe
SPLITS.why_CALIB_is_legitimate_here: load_paired_bank draws legacy states only from 10700001..10700096, so the CALIB block was never trained on. It probes generalisation without spending EVAL.

1_latent_divergence.quantity: mean JSD(pi(.|s,z0), pi(.|s,z1)) in bits, decision-masked
1_latent_divergence.reading: V1 reproduced 1.3% of available teacher contrast; this measures how much OG-PSP reproduced

2_crossed_teacher_match.quantity: decision-masked per-head agreement, all four combinations
2_crossed_teacher_match.why_crossed: Comparing each latent only against its OWN teacher cannot distinguish 'latents specialised' from 'a shared state-conditional map'. The crossed comparison is what exposed V1's actual failure and was never computed by V1's original diagnostic.

3_generalisation_of_the_differentiation.quantity: both measurements reported FIT vs CALIB separately
3_generalisation_of_the_differentiation.reading: High divergence on FIT that collapses on CALIB means the pairing itself was memorised on bank states rather than learned as specialist identity. That is a distinct failure mode from V1's and must be distinguishable.

METRIC_DISCIPLINE.decision_masked: All agreement and divergence figures are decision-masked. An unmasked pass once produced 38.1% where the masked figure was 94.7%, and briefly looked like it contradicted the original diagnostic.
METRIC_DISCIPLINE.reuse_v1_functions: Uses diagnose_oracle_gated_k2_fit_calib._agreement and the same JSD path, so the OG-PSP numbers are directly comparable to V1's rather than merely similar-looking.

PREREGISTERED_READINGS.mechanism_worked: JSD substantially above 0.0051 AND crossed gaps substantially above ~2 pp, with both surviving on CALIB. z carries specialist identity.
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.mechanism_failed: JSD still near 0.005 and crossed gaps still ~2 pp. Paired supervision did not force differentiation, and no bank size or budget would have.
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.memorised_pairing: Strong on FIT, collapses on CALIB. The network learned the bank's pairing rather than specialist identity.
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.note: These are readings, not gates. The scientific verdict remains the frozen EVAL crossover.

SEQUENCE: separate PI decision to open EVAL
